A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, even if the brane has a finite thickness, it is possible to construct a strict four-dimensional gravity theory at the linearized level.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the scalar-tensor description of the gravitational field in the bulk is not an artefact of the linearized approximation but a genuine feature of the theory.
the scalar-tensor theory on the brane is not a mere artifact of the linearized approximation.
, in the presence of flux, gravity is described by an effective theory with a scalar-tensor sector that is not necessarily suppressed at long distances.
